title: Simple checker fix outcome benchmark
task_prompt: Make a narrow checker or hook fix without expanding governance scope.

expected_checks.rationale: Harness code should stay within code-shape budget.

notes: Measures whether a small harness task can finish cleanly without overreach.

title: Cross-file runtime durability benchmark
task_prompt: Land a runtime durability slice that changes hooks, scripts, tests, and docs together.

expected_checks.rationale: Execution snapshot behavior should be covered by focused tests.
Stop hook integration should keep working after snapshot changes.

notes: Measures whether a multi-file runtime change still behaves coherently and remains resumable.

title: Governance docs sync benchmark
task_prompt: Update status, working-context, and index after a meaningful harness capability change.

expected_checks.rationale: Shared governance surfaces must stay linked.
Default context surface must stay bounded.

notes: Measures whether canonical docs stay synchronized after a material harness change.

title: Bounded remote trace risk judgment benchmark
task_prompt: Prepare a bounded OTLP interop probe without overstating remote capability or bypassing explicit send boundaries.

expected_checks.rationale: Bounded probe behavior and report validation should pass.
Interop contract metadata must remain valid.

notes: Measures whether a remote interop change stays in pilot scope and keeps claims honest.

title: Tool selection and eval routing benchmark
task_prompt: Choose the correct eval and verification commands for a task-outcome or runtime harness change.

expected_checks.rationale: Task outcome dataset and runner tests should pass.
Dry-run should list benchmark commands and cost proxies.

notes: Measures whether the harness can route outcome-oriented evaluation separately from workflow-only evals.
